description.content: Booking Api Service
Submit a real transport booking to DSV to move a package from A to B.

query.description:
These are the supported label types
- pdf
- zpl

If a "labelType" is not added to the request the label response will default to "pdf"

These are the supported print formats
- Landscape
- Portrait

If a "printFormat" is not added to the request the label response will default to "Landscape"
